info.name: Warranty Claims API
info.description:
Walks the warranty workflow: registering products, warranty expiry, filing claims, duplicate-claim protection, agent decisions through repair, rejection reasons and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8107). Repeatable: it registers a fresh customer and uses unique serial numbers.

exec: const monthsAgo = (m) => { const t = new Date(); t.setMonth(t.getMonth() - m); return iso(t); };

item.name: Register a fresh customer for this run

exec: pm.test("Serial is upper-cased, warranty is active", () => {
pm.test("Registered but not covered", () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.warrantyActive).to.be.false; pm.expect(p.daysLeft).to.be.below(0); });

item.name: Same serial again (different case) is rejected
Another customer cannot reuse the serial
Purchase more than 10 years ago is rejected

exec: pm.test("Finds product A", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("productAId")); });

item.name: Another customer does not see my products
Expired warranty cannot generate a claim
A second active claim for the same product is a conflict
The product now shows an open claim

exec: pm.test("Found with customer details", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].customerUsername).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("newUser")); });

item.name: Start repair before approval is a conflict
Complete before repair is a conflict

exec: pm.test("Approved and recorded", () => { const c = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.status).to.eql("APPROVED"); pm.expect(c.decidedBy).to.eql("agent"); });

item.name: An approved claim cannot be rejected

exec: pm.test("In repair", () => { const c = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.status).to.eql("IN_REPAIR"); pm.expect(c.repairStartedAt).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: A claim in repair still blocks a new one

exec: pm.test("Completed with the note", () => { const c = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.status).to.eql("COMPLETED"); pm.expect(c.resolutionNote).to.eql("Replaced the display panel"); });

item.name: Starting repair again is a conflict
A finished claim no longer blocks a new one
Agent rejects it with a reason

exec: pm.test("Rejected with the reason", () => { const c = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.status).to.eql("REJECTED"); pm.expect(c.rejectionReason).to.include("not covered"); });

item.name: Another customer sees none of these claims
Agent has no personal claims list
